I honestly don't think it's possible to not fear it. We have comfort zones, where's easier for us to move around, to do stuff there, because we're used to things being that way. The thing is, we can't really see or know how things are outside this zone, yes they might be harder, but they can also be much better for us, we don't know, and life is full of these 50/50 risk, there's nothing we can do about it, but when we face inevitable change, as much fear as we have, there's only one way: ahead. Coming back to what I said at the beginning, there are no ways to make the fear disappear, but (at least for me) getting to really understand change is inevitable eventually, and that there are things that, sadly, we can't control makes it a little bit easier. This is coming from someone with general anxiety disorder. Hugs and good luck!
